description: This file implements SOAP web service handlers for portal user authentication and operations within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes functions for login, session validation, logout, retrieving records and related data, setting entries, handling notes, and managing subscriptions, using the SOAP protocol and SuiteCRM's bean framework.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: Class responsible for error handling and generating SOAP-compatible error arrays.

classes.name: NoteSoap
classes.description: Class for handling note file attachments in the context of SOAP operations.

methods.name: portal_login
methods.description: Authenticates a portal user, starts a session, and returns session ID or error.

methods.name: portal_validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates an existing session ID, ensures session is active and matches client IP.

methods.name: portal_logout
methods.description: Destroys the session, logs out the user.

methods.name: portal_get_sugar_id
methods.description: Returns the internal system ID for the current portal session.

methods.name: portal_get_sugar_contact_id
methods.description: Returns the contact ID associated with the current session.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries for a given module, with optional filtering.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list_filter
methods.description: Retrieves filtered list of entries based on name-value pairs.

methods.name: portal_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific record by ID from a given module.

methods.name: portal_set_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates a record in a specific module.

methods.name: portal_set_note_attachment
methods.description: Uploads a note attachment and links it to a note entry.

methods.name: portal_remove_note_attachment
methods.description: Removes an attachment from a note.

methods.name: portal_get_note_attachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment file associated with a note.

methods.name: portal_relate_note_to_module
methods.description: Links a note to a specified module record.

methods.name: portal_get_related_notes
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to a specific contact or module record.

methods.name: portal_get_related_list
methods.description: Retrieves related records from a linked module.

methods.name: portal_get_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves the fields available in a module for the portal.

methods.name: portal_get_subscription_lists
methods.description: Retrieves the list of newsletter subscription options for the user.
